title: 实现本地账号认证核心与安全会话存储
changed_contracts: Adds the internal GatewayAuth local-primary-identity and opaque browser-session port contract; no public wire contract or HTTP route changed.
Adds production migration 10 for GatewayAuth local credential and browser session state, advancing the exact embedded migration readiness contract from 9 to 10.
risks: The component intentionally has no production account provisioning, password change/recovery or breached-secret screening entry point; exposing a direct database seeding path would bypass the approved enrollment policy.

The current Host remains HTTP-only and has no login route. HTTPS, __Host- cookie attributes, Origin enforcement, upstream request/concurrency limiting and deployment secret lifecycle must be completed before any external authentication endpoint is enabled.
OIDC is only a verified-primary-identity adapter boundary; discovery, callback validation, nonce/state/PKCE and provider configuration are not implemented.
The updated Linux PostgreSQL 16.15 CI definition was source-tested locally but GitHub-hosted CI was not executed in this thread.

architecture_review.module: GatewayAuth local authentication core, secure browser session application services and PostgreSQL adapter
reused_existing_logic: Reuses GatewayAuth AuthenticatedSubject and authenticated_principal as the only identity and administrator fact source.
Reuses the V01-003 production migration manifest, fixed owner/runtime roles, SECURITY DEFINER pattern, backup-before-apply and PostgreSQL 16.15 verification.
Reuses the centrally locked Npgsql 10.0.3 dependency and existing CoreServer modular-monolith assembly; no new package or host was added.
Extends the existing fast-merge-database job so the same PostgreSQL service exercises the C# authentication store instead of creating a parallel CI tier.
cross_module_access: All new persistent objects and functions remain inside gateway_auth and are owned by assetlibrary_gateway_auth_owner.
The runtime role has no direct table access and can execute only the bounded GatewayAuth functions granted by migration 10.
Domain and Application contain no Npgsql, ASP.NET, filesystem, network or operating-system dependency; Infrastructure implements the two application ports.
contract_changes: Adds internal local credential verification, verified primary identity and opaque session/CSRF contracts without changing contracts/** or generated SDKs.
Adds append-only migration 10; migrations 1 through 9, roles.sql and bootstrap.sql remain unchanged.
Advances CoreServer database readiness expectations to the exact ten-migration ledger while preserving fail-closed pending, extra and drift outcomes.
architecture_tests: Locked restore, format/analyzer verification, zero-warning Release build and all 210 .NET tests passed; GatewayAuth WebGateway suite is 26/26.
All 59 database tests passed against a real disposable PostgreSQL 16.15 server; the final expanded backoff-cap path also passed in a focused rerun.
54 repository, 14 architecture and 32 release tests passed; migration, .NET source and Alpha integration validators passed.
v0.1-start remains allowed, while Alpha --require-ready and v0.1-release retain exit code 3 with production authentication and all prior release blockers intact.
technical_debt: Implement an owner-only production account provisioning and recovery flow with common/breached-secret screening, audit and session-version rotation.
Compose the component into the shared Host only after TLS, persistent key, secure cookie, Origin/CSRF and upstream abuse-control boundaries are implemented.
Implement and separately validate an OIDC primary-identity adapter if deployment requirements need it; local authentication remains independently functional.
Keep business APIs and every production file-write path disabled until their existing integration and durability gates close.
